def policies.bucket_policy_is_allowed
  (statements : Slice stmts.BPStatement) (args : stmts.BucketPolicyArgs)
  (env : condfuncs.Env) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← policies.bp_denies_pass statements args env
  if b
  then
    if args.is_owner
    then ok true
    else policies.bp_some_allow statements args env
  else ok false
